    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ControlPanel
    Panel with buttons to control the program
    DuplicateEquipmentCodeException
    Exception to address when two equipment have the same code
    DuplicateUserCodeException
    Exception to address when two users have the same name
    Equipment
    Class that represets an equipment given a type and a code.
    EquipmentManager
    Dialog that let's the user manage the LabMonitor's equipment
    EquipmentPanel
    Panel that shows a table with the equipment's type, code and status.
    EquipmentStatus
    Represents the possible status of an equipment
    EquipmentStorageFullException
    Exception to address when the lab can't add more equipment due to de storage being full.
    EventLogPanel
    Panel that shows the user a table containing event log messages.
    ExceptionTest
     
    Frame
    Frame of the GUI.
    LabListener
    Functional interface that allows for LabMonitor's listening.
    LabMonitor
    The lab monitor class is the monitor for the management of the resources (Equipment) requested by threads(RequestTaks).
    LabSnapshot
    This class enables the creation of snapshots of the lab state.
    Main
    Main class of the project, contains the main method.
    MainViewPanel
    Panel with the main view of the program.
    Request
    This class is used to create requests.
    RequestManager
    Dialog that lets the user create new requests.
    RequestPanel
    JPanel to show all the requests made in the session.
    RequestStatus
    Represents the possible status of a request
    RequestTask
    Class that makes requests "runnable"
    SettingsPanel
    Panel to show the user the program's credits and allow for simulation parameter's editing
    SimulationTest
     
    User
    Class that represents a user with a given name and a unique code
    UserManager
    JDialog to show the user all of the lab's users it also gives the possibility to add a new user by inserting the user's name in the textfield and pressing a confirm button
